summary: All 9 routes, shared components, hooks, and API layer implemented. Build verification requires npm install first. One design divergence noted (card layout vs table).

concerns.description: PaperListPage and RepoListPage use a card grid layout instead of the SortableTable row layout specified in the page component lists. Card layout was chosen because: (1) SortableTable is mentioned in page component lists but not defined in shared_components, (2) cards render paper/repo metadata more readably, (3) cards scale better on desktop. If tables are strongly preferred, a SortableTable shared component should be created and the list pages refactored.
concerns.recommendation: QA should verify the card layout is acceptable; if not, create SortableTable component and rework both list pages.

concerns.description: Sidebar navigation icons use Unicode emoji characters instead of SVG icon components. Emoji rendering varies by OS and browser. For production, consider replacing with an icon library (e.g. lucide-react or heroicons).
concerns.recommendation: Acceptable for V1; upgrade to SVG icons in V2.

concerns.description: npm install has not been run. The project needs dependencies installed before it can build. Run: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
concerns.recommendation: Run npm install and verify the build succeeds with no TypeScript errors.

concerns.description: The multi-select source/language filter uses native HTML <select multiple> which has poor UX on desktop (requires Ctrl+Click). Consider replacing with a chip-based multi-select component.
concerns.recommendation: Acceptable for V1; enhance in V2.

concerns.description: Authors and Authors/:id API endpoints are implemented in the API layer (api/authors.ts) but there is no author browsing page. The API contract includes these endpoints but the handoff does not specify author routes.
concerns.recommendation: API functions available for future use; no page needed for V1.

verification_steps: 1. cd frontend && npm install && npm run build -- verify zero TypeScript errors
2. npm run dev -- start dev server on port 5173
3. Verify Dashboard loads at / with stats from GET /api/v1/stats
4. Navigate to /papers -- verify card grid, filters (source, date, tags, search), pagination
5. Click a paper card -- verify PaperDetailPage with full metadata, external links, tag management
6. Navigate to /repos -- verify card grid, filters (language, stars, search), pagination
7. Click a repo card -- verify RepoDetailPage with stats, topics, tags
8. Navigate to /tags -- verify CRUD: create, inline edit name/color, delete with confirm dialog
9. Navigate to /reports -- verify table list with type filter, status badges
10. Click a report -- verify Markdown renders with syntax highlighting and GFM tables
11. Click Regenerate on a report -- verify POST /reports/:id/retry is called
12. Navigate to /crawls -- verify scheduler job cards and crawl log table
13. Click Trigger Now on arxiv/github -- verify POST /crawls/trigger/:source
14. Verify loading skeletons appear before data loads
15. Verify error states show red banner on API failures
16. Verify empty states show friendly message when no data
17. Verify sidebar active link highlighting on each page
19. Verify all external links open in new tabs with rel=noopener noreferrer
